_about: Region pack for Germany. Everything the engine needs to know about WHERE: which countries are searched, which languages the local market works in, which boards to sweep, what counts as a wall, and how work authorization moves a score. Patterns are written in plain letters (umlauts folded: ae oe ue ss) and matched against the folded text of the full posting. Copy this folder to start another country; /region in Claude Code does it for you.
name: Germany

routes.de_post_study: Germany, after graduation (job-search permit, then Blue Card)
routes.de_skilled_worker: Germany, skilled-worker permit or EU Blue Card

route_rules.note: Student or research assistant at a university or institute: outside the 140-day account, no extra permission (+1)
Thesis in Germany: study purpose, uses no work days (+1). Ask the Ausländerbehörde before signing a paid thesis contract
Working student, voluntary internship or other student job in Germany: uses the 140-day account (0)
A career role in Germany for a student: possible after graduation (18-month job-search permit, then EU Blue Card or skilled-worker permit); check the current salary thresholds (-1)
Skilled-worker permit or EU Blue Card needs a qualifying degree, a job offer and a salary above the current threshold (-1)
A student-level role with no student status in Germany: needs an employer-sponsored permit (-3)
Switzerland applies its own quota system to non-EU nationals (-3)

route_default.note: A role outside Germany with no stated route for a non-EU applicant (-3): the host country's own permit rules apply

boards.name: Bundesagentur für Arbeit
boards.note: Public API behind the site, covers employers of every size. Watched automatically (job_watch.py, adapter bundesagentur).

boards.name: LinkedIn
boards.note: Needs a rendered browser (scripts/browser_jd_reader.py); a plain fetch is blocked by robots.txt. Job alerts by email are read by the Gmail pass.

boards.name: Xing
boards.note: German market. Alerts arrive as e-mail from jobs@mail.xing.com; the posting is JSON-LD on the page.

boards.name: StepStone
boards.note: Large general board; alert e-mail is read by the Gmail pass.

boards.name: Indeed Germany
boards.note: A plain fetch is often refused; use the Indeed connector or a browser.

boards.name: Glassdoor Germany
boards.note: Gives no posting URL: find the employer's own posting before filing it (THE LINK RULE).

boards.name: Academics
boards.note: Research and university positions, doctoral and postdoc.

boards.name: Employer career sites
boards.note: Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, SmartRecruiters, Recruitee feeds, polled by job_watch.py from profile/sources.json.
